places.name: CN Tower
places.ai_summary: The CN Tower is an iconic landmark in Toronto offering panoramic views, a glass floor, and a revolving restaurant.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary during holidays.

places.place_tip: Try the EdgeWalk for an adrenaline rush.

places.name: Royal Ontario Museum (ROM)
places.ai_summary: The Royal Ontario Museum is one of the largest museums in North America, featuring art, culture, and natural history exhibits.

opening_hours.notes: Extended hours on Fridays during special exhibitions.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the dinosaur exhibit and the Chinese temple art gallery.

places.name: Ripley's Aquarium of Canada
places.ai_summary: Ripley's Aquarium of Canada is a family-friendly attraction featuring underwater tunnels, interactive exhibits, and diverse marine life.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary during special events.

places.place_tip: Visit during weekdays to avoid crowds.

places.name: St. Lawrence Market
places.ai_summary: St. Lawrence Market is a historic market in Toronto, known for its fresh produce, gourmet foods, and unique souvenirs.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays. Hours may vary on holidays.

places.place_tip: Try the peameal bacon sandwich at Carousel Bakery.
places.address: 92 Front St E, Toronto, Ontario, Canada

places.name: Distillery District
places.ai_summary: The Distillery District is a historic area in Toronto featuring Victorian-era buildings, cobblestone streets, and a vibrant arts scene.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary for individual shops and galleries.

places.place_tip: Check out the art galleries and grab a bite at one of the local restaurants.

places.name: Art Gallery of Ontario (AGO)
places.ai_summary: The Art Gallery of Ontario is one of the most distinguished art museums in North America, with a collection that spans centuries and the globe.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays. Extended hours on Wednesdays and Fridays.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the Group of Seven paintings and the contemporary art collection.
places.address: 317 Dundas St W, Toronto, Ontario, Canada

attribution.description: Construction for Gehry redevelopment of the AGO

places.name: Toronto Islands
places.ai_summary: The Toronto Islands are a group of small islands in Lake Ontario, offering parks, beaches, and a scenic view of the Toronto skyline.

opening_hours.notes: Ferry service to the islands operates from early morning until late evening.

places.place_tip: Take the ferry from Jack Layton Ferry Terminal and explore the islands by bike or on foot.

places.name: Casa Loma
places.ai_summary: Casa Loma is a Gothic Revival style mansion and garden in Toronto, which is now a museum and landmark.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays. Last admission one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Explore the gardens and don't miss the view from the tower.

places.name: Hockey Hall of Fame
places.ai_summary: The Hockey Hall of Fame is a museum dedicated to the history of ice hockey, located in Toronto, Canada.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary on holidays.

places.place_tip: Check out the interactive exhibits and the Stanley Cup display.

places.name: Kensington Market
places.ai_summary: Kensington Market is a vibrant and eclectic neighborhood in Toronto, known for its bohemian atmosphere, vintage shops, and diverse food options.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary for individual shops and restaurants.

places.place_tip: Explore the side streets and don't miss the local eateries.

places.name: Nathan Phillips Square
places.ai_summary: Nathan Phillips Square is a public square in Toronto, known for its iconic Toronto sign, fountains, and as a gathering place for events and festivals.

opening_hours.notes: The square is always open, but events and facilities have specific hours.

places.place_tip: Visit the square at night to see the Toronto sign illuminated.
places.address: Nathan Phillips Square, Toronto, Ontario, Canada

places.name: High Park
places.ai_summary: High Park is Toronto's largest public park, featuring walking trails, gardens, a lake, and recreational facilities.

opening_hours.notes: The park is open year-round, but some facilities may be seasonal.

places.best_time_to_visit: Spring for cherry blossoms, Fall for foliage
places.place_tip: Visit the High Park Zoo and take a stroll through the beautiful gardens.

places.name: Entertainment District
places.ai_summary: The Entertainment District is a vibrant area in Toronto known for its theaters, restaurants, nightlife, and the iconic CN Tower.

opening_hours.notes: The district is always open, but individual venues have specific hours.

places.place_tip: Catch a show at the Royal Alexandra Theatre or enjoy the nightlife on King Street.
places.advanced_booking: Recommended for shows and fine dining

places.name: Scotiabank Arena
places.ai_summary: Scotiabank Arena is a multi-purpose arena in Toronto, home to the Toronto Maple Leafs (NHL) and Toronto Raptors (NBA).

opening_hours.notes: Hours vary depending on events and game schedules.

places.place_tip: Experience the excitement of a live sports event or concert.

places.name: Rogers Centre
places.ai_summary: Rogers Centre is a multi-purpose stadium in Toronto, known for hosting major concerts, sports events, and the iconic SkyDome.

opening_hours.notes: Hours vary depending on events and game schedules.

places.place_tip: Visit the Rogers Centre website for the event schedule and ticket information.
places.address: 1 Blue Jays Way, Toronto, Ontario, Canada

places.name: Ontario Science Centre
places.ai_summary: The Ontario Science Centre is a science museum in Toronto, featuring interactive exhibits, live demonstrations, and an IMAX theatre.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays. Hours may vary for special events.

places.place_tip: Check out the interactive science exhibits and the live science demonstrations.
places.address: 770 Don Mills Rd, Toronto, Ontario, Canada

places.name: Toronto Zoo
places.ai_summary: The Toronto Zoo is one of the largest zoos in the world, featuring a wide variety of animals and habitats.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary depending on the season and special events.

places.place_tip: Visit the Giant Panda Exhibit and the Tundra Trek.

places.ai_summary: Graffiti Alley is a famous alley in Toronto known for its vibrant street art and graffiti murals.

opening_hours.notes: The alley is always open, but the best time to visit is during the day for photography.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera to capture the amazing street art.

places.name: Yonge-Dundas Square
places.ai_summary: Yonge-Dundas Square is a public square in downtown Toronto, known for its bright lights, shopping, and entertainment options.

opening_hours.notes: The square is always open, but individual events and shops have specific hours.

places.place_tip: Enjoy the street performances and visit the nearby Eaton Centre.

places.name: Harbourfront Centre
places.ai_summary: Harbourfront Centre is a cultural organization at the waterfront in Toronto, featuring galleries, studios, and performance spaces.

opening_hours.notes: Hours vary depending on the season and events.

places.place_tip: Check the schedule for concerts and cultural events at the waterfront.
places.address: 235 Queens Quay W, Toronto, Ontario, Canada
